<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Ledgerly — Invoicing that chases late payments for you</title>
<meta name="description" content="Ledgerly sends your invoices, chases late payments automatically and shows what you're owed at a glance. Free for up to 3 clients.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='8' fill='%23191915'/%3E%3Cpath d='M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8' stroke='%23F4F0E6' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='22.5' cy='21' r='2.6' fill='%233FA772'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --paper: #F4F0E6;
    --paper-2: #ECE6D7;
    --card: #FFFDF8;
    --ink: #191915;
    --ink-2: #45433C;
    --muted: #757166;
    --line: #DDD5C3;
    --line-soft: #E8E2D3;
    --green: #1E6B47;
    --green-2: #3FA772;
    --green-soft: #DDEBDF;
    --amber: #A9490C;
    --amber-soft: #F7E3CF;
    --radius: 14px;
    --serif: "Instrument Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --sans: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    --mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;
    --shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(25,25,21,.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(25,25,21,.18);
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  }
  img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  a { color: inherit; }
  h1, h2, h3 { margin: 0; font-weight: 400; }
  p { margin: 0; }
  .sr-only {
    position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
  }
  .wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

  .mono { font-family: var(--mono); font-feature-settings: "tnum"; }
  .eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12.5px;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
  }

  /* ---------- Buttons & form ---------- */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
    height: 48px; padding: 0 22px;
    border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--ink);
    font: 500 16px/1 var(--sans);
    text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
    transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); }
  .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
  .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .btn-sm { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 15px; }
  .btn .arrow { transition: transform .18s ease; }
  .btn:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

  .signup { width: 100%; max-width: 480px; }
  .signup-row {
    display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 999px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    transition: border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .signup-row:focus-within { border-color: var(--ink); }
  .signup input {
    flex: 1; min-width: 0;
    border: 0; background: transparent;
    padding: 0 16px;
    font: 400 16px var(--sans); color: var(--ink);
  }
  .signup input::placeholder { color: #9A9588; }
  .signup input:focus { outline: none; }
  .signup .btn { height: 46px; }
  .signup-note {
    margin-top: 14px;
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 18px;
    font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .signup-note span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .signup-note svg { color: var(--green); flex: none; }
  .signup-error { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--amber); min-height: 0; }
  .signup-error:empty { display: none; }
  .signup-done {
    display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 18px 20px;
    background: var(--green-soft);
    border: 1px solid #BCD7C3;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: #173F2C;
  }
  .signup-done strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .signup-done p { font-size: 15px; }
  .signup-done .tick {
    flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green); color: #fff;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
  }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  .nav {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(244,240,230,.86);
    backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .nav.scrolled { border-bottom-color: var(--line); }
  .nav-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 68px; }
  .logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; }
  .nav-links a:not(.btn) { text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .nav-links a:not(.btn):hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero { padding: 72px 0 112px; }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.02fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
  .hero h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(46px, 6.2vw, 86px);
    line-height: .98;
    letter-spacing: -.015em;
    margin: 18px 0 24px;
  }
  .hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--green); }
  .hero .lede { font-size: 19px; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 30em; margin-bottom: 32px; }
  .pill-tag {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 12px 6px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .pill-tag b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; }

  /* Dashboard mock */
  .stage {
    position: relative;
    padding: 28px;
    border-radius: 22px;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 31px, rgba(25,25,21,.06) 31px 32px),
      var(--paper-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .stage::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 52px; width: 1px;
    background: rgba(169,73,12,.22);
  }
  .dash {
    position: relative;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .dash-head { padding: 22px 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }
  .dash-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; }
  .dash-label { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .dash-total { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 54px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin-top: 6px; }
  .dash-total small { font-size: .5em; color: var(--muted); vertical-align: .6em; margin-right: 2px; }
  .dash-sub { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 6px; }
  .split { display: flex; gap: 3px; height: 8px; margin: 18px 0 12px; border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; }
  .split span { display: block; height: 100%; }
  .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 18px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .legend i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block; }
  .legend .mono { color: var(--ink); }

  .rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 6px 0; }
  .row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
    padding: 11px 24px;
  }
  .row + .row { border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-soft); }
  .avatar {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .row-main { min-width: 0; }
  .row-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .row-meta { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .row-right { text-align: right; }
  .row-amt { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; }
  .status {
    display: inline-block; margin-top: 3px;
    font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500;
    padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .s-late { background: var(--amber-soft); color: var(--amber); }
  .s-due { background: #ECE8DD; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .s-paid { background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); }

  .toast {
    position: absolute; left: -28px; bottom: -34px;
    display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start;
    max-width: 330px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(25,25,21,.5);
    font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.4;
    animation: toast-in .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .9s both;
  }
  .toast-icon {
    flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(244,240,230,.12);
    display: grid; place-items: center; color: #9ED6B4;
  }
  .toast b { font-weight: 600; }
  .toast q { color: #CFC9BA; font-style: italic; }
  @keyframes toast-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(.98); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }

  /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
  section { scroll-margin-top: 72px; }
  .section { padding: 112px 0; }
  .section-head { max-width: 680px; margin-bottom: 56px; }
  .section-head h2, .h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(38px, 4.6vw, 60px);
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -.01em;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }
  .section-head h2 em, .h2 em { font-style: italic; }
  .section-head p { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink-2); }

  /* Steps */
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
  .step {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .step-copy { padding: 26px 26px 28px; }
  .step-num { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .step h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.05; margin: 8px 0 10px; }
  .step p { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 16px; }
  .step-vis {
    margin-top: auto;
    padding: 22px;
    min-height: 230px;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .mini {
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    font-size: 13px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -14px rgba(25,25,21,.35);
  }
  .mini-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .mini-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
  .line-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); color: var(--ink-2); }
  .line-item .mono { color: var(--ink); }
  .line-item.total { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); }
  .mini-send {
    margin-top: 12px; width: 100%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
    height: 34px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-weight: 500;
  }

  .sched { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
  .sched li {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .sched .when { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
  .sched .tone { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; background: #ECE8DD; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .sched li.done { background: var(--green-soft); border-color: #BCD7C3; color: #173F2C; }
  .sched li.done .when { color: var(--green); }

  .bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; height: 70px; margin: 14px 0 4px; }
  .bars span { flex: 1; border-radius: 4px 4px 2px 2px; background: #D9D2C1; }
  .bars span.now { background: var(--green); }
  .bars-x { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .kpi { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); }
  .kpi small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
  .kpi .mono { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
  .kpi.late .mono { color: var(--amber); }

  /* Chase spotlight */
  .chase { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .chase .eyebrow { color: #A7A293; }
  .chase-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: start; }
  .chase .h2 em { color: #9ED6B4; }
  .chase-lede { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 18px; color: #CFC9BA; max-width: 30em; }
  .chase-points { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 36px 0 0; display: grid; gap: 22px; }
  .chase-points li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr; gap: 14px; }
  .chase-points .ic {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.18);
    display: grid; place-items: center; color: #9ED6B4;
  }
  .chase-points b { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .chase-points p { color: #B9B3A4; font-size: 15.5px; }

  .timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; }
  .timeline::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 14px; bottom: 30px; width: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(244,240,230,.25), rgba(244,240,230,.25) 80%, rgba(63,167,114,.8));
  }
  .tl { position: relative; padding-left: 44px; padding-bottom: 22px; }
  .tl:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .tl-dot {
    position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 6px;
    width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--ink); border: 2px solid #A7A293;
  }
  .tl.late .tl-dot { border-color: #E59A5E; }
  .tl.paid .tl-dot { background: var(--green-2); border-color: var(--green-2); }
  .tl-when { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; color: #A7A293; display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .tl-when .flag { color: #E59A5E; }
  .tl.paid .tl-when .flag { color: #9ED6B4; }
  .mail {
    margin-top: 8px;
    background: #24241F;
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.1);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .mail-subj { font-weight: 500; color: var(--paper); }
  .mail-body { color: #B9B3A4; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14.5px; }
  .tl.paid .mail { background: rgba(63,167,114,.14); border-color: rgba(63,167,114,.35); }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; max-width: 920px; }
  .plan {
    position: relative;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    padding: 34px;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
  }
  .plan.featured { border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .plan-badge {
    position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 34px;
    background: var(--green); color: #fff;
    font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500;
    padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 99px;
  }
  .plan-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; }
  .plan-for { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; margin-top: 2px; }
  .price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin: 22px 0 24px; }
  .price-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 68px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .price-per { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
  .plan ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 30px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
  .plan li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr; gap: 10px; font-size: 15.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .plan li svg { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--green); }
  .plan li strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .plan .btn { margin-top: auto; width: 100%; }
  .plan-foot { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
  .pricing-note { margin-top: 28px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; max-width: 920px; }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr; gap: 64px; }
  .faq { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .faq summary {
    list-style: none; cursor: pointer;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px;
    padding: 22px 0;
    font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500;
  }
  .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  .faq summary .plus { flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; }
  .faq details[open] summary .plus { transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }
  .faq summary:hover .plus { border-color: var(--ink); }
  .faq .answer { padding: 0 48px 24px 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 16px; }

  /* Final CTA */
  .final { padding: 0 0 112px; }
  .final-card {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    padding: 72px 56px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 39px, rgba(30,107,71,.12) 39px 40px),
      var(--green-soft);
    border: 1px solid #BCD7C3;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; align-items: end;
  }
  .final-card .h2 { margin-top: 0; }
  .final-card .h2 em { color: var(--green); }
  .final-card p.sub { margin-top: 16px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 18px; }

  /* Footer */
  footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 40px 0 48px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
  .foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .foot nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .foot a { text-decoration: none; }
  .foot a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

  /* Reveal */
  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
  .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 1040px) {
    .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 56px; }
    .hero-copy { max-width: 640px; }
    .stage { max-width: 620px; }
    .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 620px; }
    .chase-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 56px; }
    .faq-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
    .final-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 56px 40px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .nav-links a:not(.btn) { display: none; }
    .hero { padding: 40px 0 88px; }
    .section { padding: 80px 0; }
    .section-head { margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .pricing-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .final { padding-bottom: 80px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    body { font-size: 16px; }
    .wrap { padding: 0 20px; }
    .hero .lede { font-size: 17.5px; }

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });

    // Reveal on scroll
    var items = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(entry.target); }
        });
      }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.08 });
      items.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
    } else {
      items.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('in'); });
    }
  })();
</script>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --paper: #F4F0E6;
    --paper-2: #ECE6D7;
    --card: #FFFDF8;
    --ink: #191915;
    --ink-2: #45433C;
    --muted: #757166;
    --line: #DDD5C3;
    --line-soft: #E8E2D3;
    --green: #1E6B47;
    --green-2: #3FA772;
    --green-soft: #DDEBDF;
    --amber: #A9490C;
    --amber-soft: #F7E3CF;
    --radius: 14px;
    --serif: "Instrument Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --sans: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    --mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;
    --shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(25,25,21,.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(25,25,21,.18);
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  }
  img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  a { color: inherit; }
  h1, h2, h3 { margin: 0; font-weight: 400; }
  p { margin: 0; }
  .sr-only {
    position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
  }
  .wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

  .mono { font-family: var(--mono); font-feature-settings: "tnum"; }
  .eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12.5px;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
  }

  /* ---------- Buttons & form ---------- */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
    height: 48px; padding: 0 22px;
    border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--ink);
    font: 500 16px/1 var(--sans);
    text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
    transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); }
  .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
  .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .btn-sm { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 15px; }
  .btn .arrow { transition: transform .18s ease; }
  .btn:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

  .signup { width: 100%; max-width: 480px; }
  .signup-row {
    display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 999px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    transition: border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .signup-row:focus-within { border-color: var(--ink); }
  .signup input {
    flex: 1; min-width: 0;
    border: 0; background: transparent;
    padding: 0 16px;
    font: 400 16px var(--sans); color: var(--ink);
  }
  .signup input::placeholder { color: #9A9588; }
  .signup input:focus { outline: none; }
  .signup .btn { height: 46px; }
  .signup-note {
    margin-top: 14px;
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 18px;
    font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .signup-note span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .signup-note svg { color: var(--green); flex: none; }
  .signup-error { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--amber); min-height: 0; }
  .signup-error:empty { display: none; }
  .signup-done {
    display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 18px 20px;
    background: var(--green-soft);
    border: 1px solid #BCD7C3;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: #173F2C;
  }
  .signup-done strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .signup-done p { font-size: 15px; }
  .signup-done .tick {
    flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green); color: #fff;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
  }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  .nav {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
    background: rgba(244,240,230,.86);
    backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .nav.scrolled { border-bottom-color: var(--line); }
  .nav-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 68px; }
  .logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; }
  .nav-links a:not(.btn) { text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .nav-links a:not(.btn):hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero { padding: 72px 0 112px; }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.02fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
  .hero h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(46px, 6.2vw, 86px);
    line-height: .98;
    letter-spacing: -.015em;
    margin: 18px 0 24px;
  }
  .hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--green); }
  .hero .lede { font-size: 19px; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 30em; margin-bottom: 32px; }
  .pill-tag {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 12px 6px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .pill-tag b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; }

  /* Dashboard mock */
  .stage {
    position: relative;
    padding: 28px;
    border-radius: 22px;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 31px, rgba(25,25,21,.06) 31px 32px),
      var(--paper-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .stage::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 52px; width: 1px;
    background: rgba(169,73,12,.22);
  }
  .dash {
    position: relative;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .dash-head { padding: 22px 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }
  .dash-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; }
  .dash-label { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .dash-total { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 54px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin-top: 6px; }
  .dash-total small { font-size: .5em; color: var(--muted); vertical-align: .6em; margin-right: 2px; }
  .dash-sub { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 6px; }
  .split { display: flex; gap: 3px; height: 8px; margin: 18px 0 12px; border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; }
  .split span { display: block; height: 100%; }
  .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 18px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .legend i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block; }
  .legend .mono { color: var(--ink); }

  .rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 6px 0; }
  .row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
    padding: 11px 24px;
  }
  .row + .row { border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-soft); }
  .avatar {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .row-main { min-width: 0; }
  .row-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .row-meta { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .row-right { text-align: right; }
  .row-amt { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; }
  .status {
    display: inline-block; margin-top: 3px;
    font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500;
    padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .s-late { background: var(--amber-soft); color: var(--amber); }
  .s-due { background: #ECE8DD; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .s-paid { background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); }

  .toast {
    position: absolute; left: -28px; bottom: -34px;
    display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start;
    max-width: 330px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(25,25,21,.5);
    font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.4;
    animation: toast-in .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .9s both;
  }
  .toast-icon {
    flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(244,240,230,.12);
    display: grid; place-items: center; color: #9ED6B4;
  }
  .toast b { font-weight: 600; }
  .toast q { color: #CFC9BA; font-style: italic; }
  @keyframes toast-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(.98); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }

  /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
  section { scroll-margin-top: 72px; }
  .section { padding: 112px 0; }
  .section-head { max-width: 680px; margin-bottom: 56px; }
  .section-head h2, .h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(38px, 4.6vw, 60px);
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -.01em;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }
  .section-head h2 em, .h2 em { font-style: italic; }
  .section-head p { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink-2); }

  /* Steps */
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
  .step {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .step-copy { padding: 26px 26px 28px; }
  .step-num { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .step h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.05; margin: 8px 0 10px; }
  .step p { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 16px; }
  .step-vis {
    margin-top: auto;
    padding: 22px;
    min-height: 230px;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .mini {
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    font-size: 13px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -14px rgba(25,25,21,.35);
  }
  .mini-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .mini-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
  .line-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); color: var(--ink-2); }
  .line-item .mono { color: var(--ink); }
  .line-item.total { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); }
  .mini-send {
    margin-top: 12px; width: 100%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
    height: 34px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-weight: 500;
  }

  .sched { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
  .sched li {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .sched .when { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
  .sched .tone { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; background: #ECE8DD; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .sched li.done { background: var(--green-soft); border-color: #BCD7C3; color: #173F2C; }
  .sched li.done .when { color: var(--green); }

  .bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; height: 70px; margin: 14px 0 4px; }
  .bars span { flex: 1; border-radius: 4px 4px 2px 2px; background: #D9D2C1; }
  .bars span.now { background: var(--green); }
  .bars-x { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .kpi { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); }
  .kpi small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
  .kpi .mono { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
  .kpi.late .mono { color: var(--amber); }

  /* Chase spotlight */
  .chase { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .chase .eyebrow { color: #A7A293; }
  .chase-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: start; }
  .chase .h2 em { color: #9ED6B4; }
  .chase-lede { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 18px; color: #CFC9BA; max-width: 30em; }
  .chase-points { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 36px 0 0; display: grid; gap: 22px; }
  .chase-points li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr; gap: 14px; }
  .chase-points .ic {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.18);
    display: grid; place-items: center; color: #9ED6B4;
  }
  .chase-points b { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .chase-points p { color: #B9B3A4; font-size: 15.5px; }

  .timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; }
  .timeline::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 14px; bottom: 30px; width: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(244,240,230,.25), rgba(244,240,230,.25) 80%, rgba(63,167,114,.8));
  }
  .tl { position: relative; padding-left: 44px; padding-bottom: 22px; }
  .tl:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .tl-dot {
    position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 6px;
    width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--ink); border: 2px solid #A7A293;
  }
  .tl.late .tl-dot { border-color: #E59A5E; }
  .tl.paid .tl-dot { background: var(--green-2); border-color: var(--green-2); }
  .tl-when { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; color: #A7A293; display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .tl-when .flag { color: #E59A5E; }
  .tl.paid .tl-when .flag { color: #9ED6B4; }
  .mail {
    margin-top: 8px;
    background: #24241F;
    border: 1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.1);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .mail-subj { font-weight: 500; color: var(--paper); }
  .mail-body { color: #B9B3A4; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14.5px; }
  .tl.paid .mail { background: rgba(63,167,114,.14); border-color: rgba(63,167,114,.35); }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; max-width: 920px; }
  .plan {
    position: relative;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    padding: 34px;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
  }
  .plan.featured { border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .plan-badge {
    position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 34px;
    background: var(--green); color: #fff;
    font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500;
    padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 99px;
  }
  .plan-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; }
  .plan-for { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; margin-top: 2px; }
  .price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin: 22px 0 24px; }
  .price-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 68px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .price-per { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
  .plan ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 30px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
  .plan li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr; gap: 10px; font-size: 15.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .plan li svg { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--green); }
  .plan li strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .plan .btn { margin-top: auto; width: 100%; }
  .plan-foot { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
  .pricing-note { margin-top: 28px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; max-width: 920px; }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr; gap: 64px; }
  .faq { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .faq summary {
    list-style: none; cursor: pointer;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px;
    padding: 22px 0;
    font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500;
  }
  .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  .faq summary .plus { flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; }
  .faq details[open] summary .plus { transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }
  .faq summary:hover .plus { border-color: var(--ink); }
  .faq .answer { padding: 0 48px 24px 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 16px; }

  /* Final CTA */
  .final { padding: 0 0 112px; }
  .final-card {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    padding: 72px 56px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 39px, rgba(30,107,71,.12) 39px 40px),
      var(--green-soft);
    border: 1px solid #BCD7C3;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; align-items: end;
  }
  .final-card .h2 { margin-top: 0; }
  .final-card .h2 em { color: var(--green); }
  .final-card p.sub { margin-top: 16px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 18px; }

  /* Footer */
  footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 40px 0 48px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
  .foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .foot nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .foot a { text-decoration: none; }
  .foot a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

  /* Reveal */
  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
  .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 1040px) {
    .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 56px; }
    .hero-copy { max-width: 640px; }
    .stage { max-width: 620px; }
    .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 620px; }

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });

    // Reveal on scroll
    var items = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(entry.target); }
        });
      }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.08 });
      items.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
    } else {
      items.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('in'); });
    }
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>

            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Start free <svg class="arrow" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button>
          </div>

</main>

        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Footer">
      <a href="#how">How it works</a>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">No. They get an email with a link to view the invoice and pay. Nothing to sign up for.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Can I cancel Pro?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">Anytime, from your account settings. No contracts and no cancellation fees.</p>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Final CTA -->
  <section class="final" id="final">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="final-card reveal">
        <div>
          <h2 class="h2">Get paid for the work <em>you already did</em>.</h2>
          <p class="sub">Free for up to 3 clients. Send your first invoice today.</p>
        </div>
        <form class="signup" data-signup novalidate>
          <div class="signup-row">
            <label class="sr-only" for="email-final">Email address</label>
            <input id="email-final" type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@yourstudio.com" autocomplete="email" required>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Start free <svg class="arrow" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button>
          </div>
          <p class="signup-error" role="alert"></p>
          <div class="signup-note">
            <span><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>No credit card</span>
            <span><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>Upgrade only if you need to</span>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap foot">
    <a class="logo" href="#top" style="font-size:16px">
      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect width="32" height="32" rx="8" fill="#191915"/>
        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Footer">
      <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>
    <span>© <span id="year">2026</span> Ledgerly</span>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  .timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; }
  .timeline::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 14px; bottom: 30px; width: 1px;

          <p class="answer">You decide when reminders go out and what they say. They stop the moment an invoice is paid, and you can pause them for any invoice. Most clients simply forgot, and a polite nudge is all it takes.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">No. They get an email with a link to view the invoice and pay. Nothing to sign up for.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Can I cancel Pro?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">Anytime, from your account settings. No contracts and no cancellation fees.</p>

  <!-- Final CTA -->

</main>

  <div class="wrap foot">
    <a class="logo" href="#top" style="font-size:16px">
      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect width="32" height="32" rx="8" fill="#191915"/>
        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Footer">
      <a href="#how">How it works</a>

      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

          <p class="answer">Ledgerly will ask you to upgrade to Pro at $12 a month. Your existing clients, invoices and reminders stay exactly as they are.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Will automatic reminders annoy my clients?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">You decide when reminders go out and what they say. They stop the moment an invoice is paid, and you can pause them for any invoice. Most clients simply forgot, and a polite nudge is all it takes.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">No. They get an email with a link to view the invoice and pay. Nothing to sign up for.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Can I cancel Pro?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">Anytime, from your account settings. No contracts and no cancellation fees.</p>
        </details>

      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect width="32" height="32" rx="8" fill="#191915"/>
        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Footer">
      <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>
    <span>© <span id="year">2026</span> Ledgerly</span>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        </details>

          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>

        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Footer">
      <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>

  </div>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>

        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>

      <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>
    <span>© <span id="year">2026</span> Ledgerly</span>
  </div>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>

        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>

      <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>
    <span>© <span id="year">2026</span> Ledgerly</span>
  </div>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
