        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>What happens when I add a fourth client?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">Ledgerly will ask you to upgrade to Pro at $12 a month. Your existing clients, invoices and reminders stay exactly as they are.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Will automatic reminders annoy my clients?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">You decide when reminders go out and what they say. They stop the moment an invoice is paid, and you can pause them for any invoice. Most clients simply forgot, and a polite nudge is all it takes.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Do my clients need a Ledgerly account?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">No. They get an email with a link to view the invoice and pay. Nothing to sign up for.</p>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Can I cancel Pro?<span class="plus" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg></span></summary>
          <p class="answer">Anytime, from your account settings. No contracts and no cancellation fees.</p>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Final CTA -->
  <section class="final" id="final">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="final-card reveal">
        <div>
          <h2 class="h2">Get paid for the work <em>you already did</em>.</h2>
          <p class="sub">Free for up to 3 clients. Send your first invoice today.</p>
        </div>
        <form class="signup" data-signup novalidate>
          <div class="signup-row">
            <label class="sr-only" for="email-final">Email address</label>
            <input id="email-final" type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@yourstudio.com" autocomplete="email" required>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Start free <svg class="arrow" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button>
          </div>
          <p class="signup-error" role="alert"></p>
          <div class="signup-note">
            <span><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>No credit card</span>
            <span><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>Upgrade only if you need to</span>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap foot">
    <a class="logo" href="#top" style="font-size:16px">
      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect width="32" height="32" rx="8" fill="#191915"/>
        <path d="M9 11h14M9 16h14M9 21h8" stroke="#F4F0E6" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="22.5" cy="21" r="2.6" fill="#3FA772"/>
      </svg>
      Ledgerly
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Footer">
      <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
    </nav>
    <span>© <span id="year">2026</span> Ledgerly</span>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  (function () {
    // Sticky nav border once the page scrolls
    var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
    var onScroll = function () { nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 8); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Sign-up forms (no backend: validate and show a confirmation)
    var emailOk = function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-signup]').forEach(function (form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var error = form.querySelector('.signup-error');
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        error.textContent = '';
        input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      });
      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var email = input.value.trim();
        if (!emailOk(email)) {
          error.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
          input.focus();
          return;
        }
        var done = document.createElement('div');
        done.className = 'signup-done';
        done.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        done.tabIndex = -1;
        done.innerHTML = '<span class="tick"><svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>' +
          '<div><strong>You’re in. Check your inbox.</strong><p></p></div>';
        done.querySelector('p').textContent = 'We sent a sign-in link to ' + email + '. Your free plan is ready for your first 3 clients.';
        form.replaceWith(done);
        done.focus();
      });
    });

    // Pricing buttons jump to the final form and focus the email field
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-email]').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('email-final');
        if (field) setTimeout(function () { field.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 450);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I've built the Ledgerly landing page as a single file, `index.html`, which opens straight from disk. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't seen how it looks at 390px or 1440px; the layout for both widths is written into the code but untested.

**What's on the page, in order:**
- **Top bar:** logo, links to each section, and a "Start free" button. It stays fixed while you scroll, and on phones only the logo and button show.
- **Opening section:** the headline "Send the invoice. We'll *chase* the payment." with an email box to sign up for the free plan, and "Free for up to 3 clients. No card needed" beside it. Next to it is a mock dashboard showing $7,840 owed, split into overdue, due soon and later, with a list of invoices and a pop-up saying a reminder was just sent.
- **How it works:** three cards — Send, Chase, See — each with a small picture of an invoice, a reminder schedule or a payment chart.
- **Late payments section (dark):** one invoice followed from sending, through the reminders, to being paid. The dates and amounts match the dashboard above.
- **Pricing:** Free ($0, up to 3 clients), marked "Start here", and Pro ($12 a month, unlimited clients). Both buttons take you to the sign-up form, since every account starts on Free.
- **FAQ, a closing sign-up box and a footer.**

All images are drawn in code inside the file, and only the fonts load from Google Fonts.

**Before this goes live:**
- **The sign-up form isn't connected to anything.** It checks the email address and then shows "You're in. Check your inbox." but nothing is actually sent or saved. You'll need to connect it to your real sign-up system.
- **Some features are my assumptions.** Your brief only listed sending invoices, chasing late payments, the "what you're owed" view and the two prices. I also wrote in that clients can pay online from the invoice, that you can edit the reminder wording and timing, that reminders can be paused for one invoice, that Pro can be cancelled anytime, and that Free has no time limit. Remove any of these that aren't true.
- **There are no testimonials or usage numbers,** because I'd have had to make them up. The client and freelancer names in the examples are invented.
